title: Python: Bug: Fix import path: microsoft.agents vs microsoft_agents
author: julienlambert706

comments.author: moonbox3
comments.body: Hi @julienlambert706, the real issue here is that our docs re: installing packages are stale. The Microsoft Agents Copilot related packages are now on public PyPI. You can install the optional dependency via `pip install semantic-kernel[copilotstudio]`. I will get the docs updated to reflect this.

comments.author: moonbox3
comments.body: The docs have been updated to reflect the proper package/extra to install: `pip install semantic-kernel[copilotstudio]`
